shared: Moths hand you free Phial spells, and the tribe grows by casting many of them on your units.
differ: What drives growth: a spell you keep rewriting, a Heat count hit exactly, or Phials aged in hand.

takes.label: Write your own spell
takes.line: Playing Moths adds effects, even other tribes' keywords, to the one spell every Phial casts, so all later Phials hit harder.
takes.look_if: to write one spell over the game, adding stats and keywords.

takes.label: Count to seven
takes.line: Every spell adds Heat, reset each turn; end on exactly 7 for bigger board buffs, or overshoot and Flare for different ones.
takes.look_if: a fresh counting puzzle every turn, buffing your whole board.

takes.label: Ripen and merge
takes.line: Phials grow each turn you hold them; a full hand merges into one huge Phial, and Echo repeats casts onto other units.
takes.look_if: to hoard in hand for one giant, planned combo pour.
